players.product: Triple Alpha quantum software development environment (hardware-agnostic compiler / deployment), run on an in-house quantum hardware testbed

quarterly_data.signal: Horizon Quantum 20-F: 2025 revenue was S$50,000 (2024: S$360,000), from research and development services on quantum algorithms; research and development expense rose 209% to S$10,696,318; loss from operations was S$22,057,337 and net loss S$23,065,676 (US$17,937,378).

Horizon Quantum 20-F: it has a joint marketing agreement with Rigetti covering Rigetti's Novera QPU and Horizon's participation in the Novera QPU Partner Program (each granting the other a royalty-free trademark license), and annual partnership agreements with Alice & Bob, Oxford Quantum Circuits and QuEra Computing under which each tests Triple Alpha on its hardware without cost to either party; none of these relationships has generated revenue yet.

connects_to.relationship: Big Fridge dilution refrigerator in Horizon Quantum's testbed

contracts.signal: Horizon Quantum 20-F: Horizon entered a material purchase commitment with Maybell Quantum Industries to purchase capital equipment for its hardware testbed; the unpaid contract value is approximately US$581 thousand, payable on delivery and acceptance, with the transaction expected to close in the second or third fiscal quarter of 2026.
contracts.units: capital equipment for the hardware testbed
